_note: Current release is entirely free. Base FF prices remain tuning only. Paid prompts require BOTH freeMode=false and paidEnabled=true, configured positive IDs, a persistent profile, and successful policy lookup. Never enable without the owner's decision.

seasonPassS1.description: Unlocks the paid column of the Season 1 track. Marks are earned by eliminating bots and clearing rounds -- the pass never earns them for you. Cosmetic rewards only.
seasonPassS1._season: Unlocks a track rather than granting on purchase, so `grants` is empty. Progression/SeasonPass hands over every paid reward up to the tier already reached the moment ownership is seen -- buying mid-season is never a punishment. A new season needs a NEW pass and a new marketplaceId; never re-sell this one.

paintPack.description: Four paint colors for your field kit: pink, cyan, lime and violet. Cosmetic only.

finishPack.description: Duracoat and Split Dust marker finishes. Headshot camos are earned separately on the field.
